preconditions.description: The number of engineers is between 1 and 100000, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: Each line contains exactly two integers
preconditions.description: Each line of input contains the number of the current desk and the number of the desired desk for an engineer.

preconditions.expression: No two engineers sit at the same desk
preconditions.description: There are no duplicate desk numbers in the input.
The desk numbers are within the range from 1 to 2*N, where N is the number of engineers.

postconditions.expression: Output is the number of possible seating arrangements
postconditions.description: The output is the number of valid seating arrangements that can be created, modulo 1000000007.
